texts.content_exam: Do you think there is life on other planets? Do you think that creatures on other planets may visit Earth one day? Have you ever seen a spaceship in real life? Well, if you haven't, someone has! In 1947, a pilot named Kenneth Arnold reported seeing nine objects resembling boomerangs in the sky. He described their movement and said that they were "like a saucer if you skip it across the water." This phenomenon is called UFO (unidentified flying objects). This term is used to describe any observations of alien spaceships. It is called unidentified because it cannot be immediately explained.

questions.question: In 1947, a pilot named Kenneth Arnold reported seeing nine objects resembling ........ in the sky.
questions.explanation:
✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: boomerangs
📝 الترجمة: في عام 1947، أبلغ طيار يدعى كينيث أرنولد عن رؤية تسعة أجسام تشبه البوميرانغ في السماء.
💡 الشرح: النص يقول: 'reported seeing nine objects resembling boomerangs in the sky.'

questions.explanation:
✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: saucer
📝 الترجمة: قال أرنولد أن الأجسام كانت 'مثل الصحن إذا قذفته عبر الماء'.
💡 الشرح: النص يقول: 'like a saucer if you skip it across the water.'

📝 الترجمة: UFO تعني أجسام طائرة مجهولة الهوية.
💡 الشرح: النص يقول: 'This phenomenon is called UFO (unidentified flying objects).'

📝 الترجمة: يستخدم هذا المصطلح لوصف أي ملاحظات لمركبات فضائية غريبة.
💡 الشرح: النص يقول: 'describe any observations of alien spaceships.'

questions.explanation:
✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: immediately
📝 الترجمة: يسمى مجهول الهوية لأنه لا يمكن تفسيره فوراً.
💡 الشرح: النص يقول: 'It is called unidentified because it cannot be immediately explained.'

texts.content_exam: Many people believed in that phenomenon, and science-fiction movies started to be made; so we can say that everyone of us has seen a spaceship either in real life or in a movie. However, this phenomenon has been studied by scientists and researchers to clarify the mystery. Researchers think that Arnold probably saw a flock of birds and couldn't tell their exact size, so he didn't know that their large wings created the "V" shape which he described. Other explanations of UFO are that some secret experiments are done by governments under the name of X-Files and so they do not always deny what is presented in movies.

💡 الشرح: النص يقول: 'we can say that everyone of us has seen a spaceship either in real life or in a movie.'

💡 الشرح: النص يقول: 'Researchers think that Arnold probably saw a flock of birds.'

💡 الشرح: النص يقول: 'they do not always deny what is presented in movies.'

💡 الشرح: النص يقول: 'Researchers think that Arnold probably saw a flock of birds.'

texts.content_exam: The Bermuda triangle is known as the horror triangle. It is a geographical area in the shape of a triangle with one million square kilometre area. In 1945, five American planes entered the field of Bermuda triangle. "We are in a world different from ours. We see white water, we are over an island. We are lost", these were the last words said by one of the pilots before the planes disappeared for good. The USA sent a search plane with 13 people on board to look for the lost aircrafts, but again the plane disappeared.

📝 الترجمة: يُعرف مثلث برمودا بمثلث الرعب.

texts.content_exam: Many explanations are offered by scientists and researchers. Some say that there are hexagonal clouds which create winds of 160 km per hour and they act as "air bombs" which sink ships and bring down planes. Others say that the cause is huge waves, swallowing up everything in their path. A third opinion is strong whirlpools, causing ships that get caught in them to sink. The strange thing is that nowadays planes and ships go over this place a lot nearly every day, but nothing happens to them. We haven't heard about planes falling or ships disappearing in this place since the last century.

texts.source_text: Abdulrahman, a Syrian child with supernatural powers
texts.content_exam: Specialists say that Abdulrahman Al-Asa'ad, from Homs, shows supernatural powers. He speaks languages which he hasn't learnt before. He works on the computer and mobile phones without training. The beginning of all of this took place when Abdulrahman was four years old. It was found out by chance that he wrote the English letters and numbers and said them correctly. He did the same with the Arabic alphabet. He also has an unbelievable visual memory. He looks at any building for a minute or two then he draws it accurately. He spends fifteen minutes only to do that using a black pen. Abdulrahman can also say the time correctly without using any clocks or watches. According to an architecture professor, his drawings are detailed and professional. He insisted that good care must be taken of Abdulrahman and he will be a great man in the future.
